title: Is it compulsory to upload neurips poster by 15th Nov? [D]
summary: I received this mail which said "Please upload your poster and thumbnail by clicking on the poster upload page link on the paper metadata page." The mail contains 15th November as a date, do we really need to upload posters ?? submitted by /u/Jealous_Key_4030 [link] [comments]
reason: Reddit Q&A post asking whether a NeurIPS poster upload deadline is compulsory. No new research artifact, model release, industry business event, policy action, or open-source tool announcement; no rule covers it.
